sentiment.rationale: Guidance was not raised in absolute terms (core constant currency EPS still 'approximately even with the prior year'), but the USD EPS outlook improved because FX headwinds moderated from a 3% to a 1.5% headwind, implying a smaller decline in core EPS (1.5% vs. 3% previously). This is a meaningful improvement in the forward outlook, even though it is partly attributed to FX. Management expressed confidence in sequential improvement in North America and sustained international growth, and the Q&A revealed a high degree of confidence in back-half productivity. The score is positive but capped at 0.20 because the improvement is partly FX-driven and the core constant currency EPS guidance was not raised.

summary.revenue: Reported net revenue of $22,726 million for Q2 2025, up 1.0% year-over-year. Organic revenue growth was 2.1%.
summary.eps: Reported GAAP EPS of $0.92 for Q2 2025, down 59% year-over-year. Core EPS (non-GAAP) was $2.12, down 5% on a core constant currency basis.
summary.guidance: For fiscal 2025, the company continues to expect low-single-digit organic revenue growth, core constant currency EPS approximately even with the prior year, a core annual effective tax rate of approximately 20%, and total cash returns to shareholders of approximately $8.6 billion. The FX headwind is now expected to be approximately 1.5 percentage points (previously 3 percentage points), implying a 1.5% decline in core EPS (previously 3%).
summary.margin: Reported gross margin was 54.7% for Q2 2025 (GAAP), core gross margin was 55.1% (non-GAAP). Reported operating margin was 7.9% (GAAP), core operating margin was 17.2% (non-GAAP).
key_risks: Impairment charges of $1.86 billion related to Rockstar and Be & Cheery brands.
Foreign exchange translation headwind of approximately 1.5 percentage points on net revenue and core EPS growth.
Challenging external environment, including tariffs and consumer pressure.
Volume declines in North America: PFNA volume flat, PBNA volume down 2% in Q2.
Weakness in China consumer post-Chinese New Year.
key_opportunities: International business momentum continuing, with mid-single-digit growth.
Accelerated productivity initiatives expected to deliver 70% more productivity in the second half vs. first half.
North America integration of foods and beverages value chain to drive efficiency and growth.
Away-from-home channel growing high single digits in PBNA and margin accretive.
Portfolio innovation in permissible snacks, protein beverages, and cleaner ingredients.
Improving cola share (Pepsi) and Gatorade share recovery.
